perspective:
From Sara Manuelito’s available perspective:

- Sara knows Shirley as a long-time nurse colleague and close friend from their shared work at a community health center; their professional relationship has deepened into friendship through shared experiences and mutual respect.
- Sara attended the funeral of a mutual patient with Shirley. She directly observed Shirley’s somber demeanor and suspected Shirley was deeply affected. Sara told Shirley she knew it was hard and that she had seen how much Shirley cared. Shirley said it had been tough, that she kept thinking something more could have been done, and that it was hard to let go. Sara replied that they did everything they could and that they should remember the good care and moments of joy they brought the patient.
- During a coffee break at work, Sara brought up their treatment decisions because she sensed Shirley felt burdened. Shirley explicitly told Sara she felt responsible, wondered if pushing for a different approach might have given the patient a better chance, appreciated Sara’s words, and said it was hard to accept. Sara said they made the best decisions with the information they had and that the burden was too heavy to carry alone.
- Sara observed Shirley continuing to be reserved and minimally expressive. In their office, Sara told Shirley she had noticed she was holding back her feelings and that it was okay to be open. Shirley said she was not sure she could, because she did not want to seem unprofessional or weak. Sara said showing emotions does not make her weak and is healthy among friends. Shirley said maybe Sara was right and she would try to be more open.
- Sara later felt her confrontation may have been too harsh and apologized to Shirley. Shirley said it had been a bit much but that she knew Sara meant well and appreciated the apology. Sara said she was there for Shirley in whatever way needed. Shirley thanked her and said they should keep talking because it helps.
- After some time, Sara noticed Shirley seemed to be doing better and felt hopeful. Sara asked how she was feeling. Shirley said she was feeling better thanks to their talks and Sara’s support. Sara offered to spend more time together outside work. Shirley agreed and suggested planning something for the weekend.
